label: PF Backlog 418
title: PF platform delivery baseline: ONE source for all editions; new shipped/sensitive logic -> Go; existing -> compiled (Nuitka); no raw .py at customer; migrate by value later
body: LOCKED delivery baseline (Go-first for new work): ONE source for all editions. NEW features -> Go (from day one; Go core B1 is mandatory). EXISTING Python -> shipped compiled (Nuitka). High-value legacy modules -> migrated to Go later by value (BI-PF-0386). No raw .py at the customer; build COMPILES (go build / Nuitka), never translates; one implementation per feature. Full Python->Go rewrite = non-goal/aspiration (compiled Python fallback for low-value remainder). SaaS runs the source; customer ships the compiled artifact + license.
